DU.title: University of Delhi: admissions
DU.covers: Admissions 2026-27 (CUET UG 2026 cycle, now closed): the Bulletin of Information for undergraduate programmes (hosted on du.ac.in, named by this site), seat matrix, CSAS schedules and notices, round-wise minimum allocation scores. No 2027-28 information yet.
DU.updateFrequency: 2026-27 cycle closed (last date of UG admissions 31 August 2026); 2027-28 not yet published
DU.reliabilityNote: Official: DU's own Bulletin of Information names admission.uod.ac.in. Review of 16 Nov 2026: eligibility for all 73 programmes read from the bulletin; schedules were revised several times; merit, tentative and candidate lists exist on the site and are never stored. About 150 B.A. combinations are not verified.
DU.approvalNote: Official - Use with Care. Approved by the CEO in the decision of 16 November 2026 (recorded by Claude Code). This approves the website as an official source; it does not approve every document or claim on it.

BHU.title: Banaras Hindu University: admissions
BHU.covers: Session 2026-27 through CUET-UG 2026 and CAP (UG) 2026 (now closed): UG information bulletin (a draft), CAP procedure document, dated notices, round cut-off CSV files.
BHU.reliabilityNote: Official (Central Admission Committee portal linked from bhu.ac.in). Review of 16 Nov 2026: the UG bulletin is a draft with internal inconsistencies (tie-break year, B.Voc duration, papers listed without any-of/all-of wording), so only facts re-checked against the raw document are held, as drafts. B.A. B.Ed. is admitted through NCET, not CUET. Allotment and non-reported lists exist and are never stored.
BHU.approvalNote: Official - Use with Care. Approved by the CEO in the decision of 16 November 2026 (recorded by Claude Code). This approves the website as an official source; it does not approve every document or claim on it.

JNU.title: JNU: entrance and admissions
JNU.covers: Admissions 2026-27: e-prospectuses for UG and COP programmes (CUET-UG) and PG programmes (CUET-PG), schedules and notices, cut-off pages that link to PDFs. Only the UG and COP programmes are held; PG is kept separate pending its own review.
JNU.reliabilityNote: Official: the site states it is the official JNU website and signed JNU notices name it. Review of 16 Nov 2026: UG and COP eligibility and CUET papers verified against the prospectus. The cut-off pages are link indexes to PDFs, not data. Result, merit-list and viva portals are separate and never stored.
